FRONT COVER (Photo:R.Linstead) Jim Vivian (64) wins the All-England Schools sprint title in 10.1 from his Surrey County team-mate and training companion Tony Oke (10.1). In August, Vivian went on to clock 9.9 in the AAA's Junior Champs; Nash of South Africa being the only man to beat him.
Jim Vivian chalked up a Belgrave record of 9.9secs for the short sprint, and although losing by inches to Nash of South Africa he had the consolation of being the fastest Englishman.
